title: donoteat DESTROYS cities:skylines industries DLC with FACTS & LOGIC
premise: Donoteat casts Industries as a state-capitalist industrial-management expansion. He tours its ore, oil, forestry and farming chains, but his main complaint is the freight system: everything travels by truck, with no way to schedule deliveries. Detours into machinery, history, chemistry and factory farming lead to a qualified recommendation to wait for mods.
coverage: The ore, oil, forestry and farming tour, freight bottlenecks, mail correction, toll-and-gin detour, labor policy and recommendation to wait for mods, through the fare-token ending. Historical and economic claims are the presenter’s account; some music and image identities remain uncertain.
